text: Campus placement voice test.
Setup phase. The guided runner will sign in and prepare campus partnerships.
Landing page ready. Home page is open. Full cycle starts with employer sign-in (automatic).
Employer role. Tech Corporation HR publishes the internship posting.
Log in as employer (TechCorp). Employer dashboard loads. Password Admin@123 via guided sign-in.
Log in as employer again. Back on employer hub — ready to publish internship.
Navigate to Internship Programs. Internship Programs list or empty state.
Scan internship list and status filter. Note draft / published / closed postings.
Click Post Internship to open the create form. Post New Internship form with campus checkboxes.
Review target campuses (pre-selected). At least one approved campus checkbox is checked.
Type internship title (includes session marker GT-…). Title shows GT-2026-06-161622 Summer Data Intern — use this marker in later steps.
Set internship start date. Start date shows 01 Jun 2026.
Set internship end date. End date shows 31 Aug 2026 (~3 months).
Type stipend minimum (INR/month). Stipend min field shows 25000.
Type stipend maximum (INR/month). Stipend max field shows 35000.
Type number of openings. Openings field shows 3.
Type minimum CGPA. Min CGPA field shows 7.5.
Type eligible branches. Eligible branches shows All (every branch).
Type batch year (2026 — matches seeded students). Batch year field shows 2026.
Type skills / keywords. Skills: Python, SQL, Data Analysis.
Type additional notes. Notes include guided test marker.
Review complete form before publish. All fields populated; campuses selected.
Click Publish Internship. Success toast; new row in list with GT- title; status Published.
Confirm posting in published list. Employer publish complete — handoff to College next.
College administrator role. IIT Madras reviews and approves the posting.
Log in as college admin. Verify employer posting is visible to campus.
Open college Internships list. Published listings from partner employers. New postings show Campus = Pending review until approved.
Search for the guided internship by marker. Table filters to GT-2026-06-161622 in the title column.
Filter campus status to Pending review. Only listings awaiting college approval remain visible.
Approve guided internship for campus. Row with GT-2026-06-161622 — click Approve (skipped if already Approved from a prior run).
Confirm campus status is Approved. Filter Campus status → Approved; GT-2026-06-161622 row shows Approved badge. Students can now browse it.
Open college Applications (monitor pipeline). Campus application list — student row appears after student applies.
Student role. Arjun applies for the internship.
Log in as student (Arjun Verma). Student dashboard — profile must have a primary CV to apply.
Open Browse Internships. Internships visible to IIT Madras including GT- posting.
Search for the guided internship by marker. Table filters to GT-2026-06-161622 in role/title.
Click Apply on the guided internship row. Success toast; status Applied. Student step done — handoff to Employer.
Confirm application status on list. Row shows Applied (not Open).
Employer role. Tech Corporation HR publishes the internship posting.
Log in as employer. Review and advance the student application.
Open Applications — Internships tab. Program applications table; Internships tab active.
Search applicants by guided internship marker. Arjun Verma row for GT- internship opening.
Shortlist the applicant. Status Applied → Shortlisted.
Select the shortlisted candidate. Status becomes Selected — employer cycle complete.
Filter list to Selected and confirm pipeline. Applicant shows Selected badge. Full E2E cycle complete.
Closure. The internship workflow is complete.
Log in as student — verify Selected status. My Applications → Internships shows Selected for GT-2026-06-161622 posting.
Open My Applications — Internships. Student sees Selected — internship full cycle verified end-to-end.

Employer role. Tech Corporation HR performs employer-side steps.
Log in as employer (TechCorp). Employer dashboard loads.
Open campus tie-up directory. IIT Madras should be Approved (or request tie-up if needed).
Request tie-up with IIT Madras (if not already Approved). Toast confirms request, or row already shows Approved.
College administrator role. IIT Madras performs campus-side steps.
Log in as college admin (IIT Madras). College hub loads — approve partnership if employer just requested tie-up.
Open Employer Partnership Requests. Pending list shows TechCorp Solutions (if request was sent).
Approve TechCorp partnership request. TechCorp row approved or already absent from pending list.
Employer role. Tech Corporation HR performs employer-side steps.
Log in as employer again. Back on employer hub — ready to request a placement drive.
Navigate to Placement Drives. Placement Drives list or empty state.
Open Request placement drive form. Full-page request form with campus selector and fields.
Select IIT Madras campus. Campus dropdown shows Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.
Type drive title (includes session marker GT-…). Title shows GT-2026-06-210819 SDE Placement Drive — use this marker in later steps.
Select drive type — On campus. Drive type shows On campus.
Set drive date (future). Drive Date field shows 15 Dec 2026.
Type venue. Venue shows CRC Seminar Hall A.
Type notes for placement office. Notes include guided test marker.
Type openings for the role. Openings field shows 10.
Type skills for the role. Skills: Java, DSA, SQL.
Type job description. Description includes guided test marker.
Type minimum CGPA. Min CGPA field shows 7.5.
Type eligible branches. Eligible branches shows All.
Type batch year (2026 — matches seeded students). Batch year field shows 2026.
Type min CTC (annual INR). Min CTC shows 800000.
Type max CTC (annual INR). Max CTC shows 1200000.
Review form before submit. All required fields populated.
Click Submit request. Success toast; drive row shows Requested status.
Confirm drive in employer list. Employer request complete — handoff to College next.
College administrator role. IIT Madras performs campus-side steps.
Log in as college admin. Approve the drive for campus visibility.
Open college Placement Drives. New drive shows Awaiting Approval with GT-2026-06-210819 in title.
Approve guided drive for campus. Row with GT-2026-06-210819 — click Approve (skipped if already Approved).
Confirm Approved status. Status pill shows Approved. Students can now apply.
Student role. Arjun Verma performs student-side steps.
Log in as student (Arjun Verma). Student dashboard — profile must have a primary CV to apply.
Open Browse Placement Drives. Drive with GT-2026-06-210819 visible when Approved.
Search for the guided drive by marker. Card list filters to GT-2026-06-210819.
Click Apply now on the guided drive. Apply confirmation modal opens.
Confirm application in modal. Success toast; card shows Applied.
Confirm Applied status. Student step done — handoff to Employer.
Employer role. Tech Corporation HR performs employer-side steps.
Log in as employer. Review and advance the student application.
Open Applications — Jobs tab. Placement drive applicants table (Jobs tab).
Search applicants by guided drive marker. Arjun Verma row for GT- drive opening.
Shortlist the applicant. Status Applied → Shortlisted.
Select the shortlisted candidate. Status becomes Selected — employer cycle complete.
Filter list to Selected and confirm pipeline. Applicant shows Selected badge.
Closure. The workflow is complete.

Setup phase. The browser opens the landing page or sign-in screen.
Landing page ready. Home page is open. Auto voice tour begins — no blue-tag clicks needed.
Employer role. Tech Corporation HR performs employer-side steps.
Log in as employer. Employer dashboard loads.
Open Assessment uploads (CSV). Tabbed Internship, Jobs, Drive, Projects — export CSV per tab.
Open Assessment Update Online. Inline editable hiring_result rows per application.
Edit hiring_result inline — manual. Change round values; Save changes shows dirty row count.
Submit results when complete — manual. Submit locks further CSV and online edits for that context.
Open Hiring Results Dashboard. Read-only summary of submitted assessment outcomes.
College administrator role. IIT Madras performs campus-side steps.
College opens Hiring Assessment. Read-only mirror of employer submitted results.
Navigate to college Hiring Assessment. Same outcomes visible to college TPO.
Log in as college admin. College hub loads. You are verifying the employer's published internship is visible to campus.
Open college Internships list. Partner listings appear as Pending review until you approve them for campus.
Search for the guided internship by marker. Table filters to GT-2026-06-241640 in the title column.
Filter campus status to Pending review. Only listings awaiting college approval remain visible.
Switch to list view. Table rows with Actions column — approve icon is easier to target in list view.
Approve guided internship for campus. Row with GT-2026-06-241640 — click Approve for campus (green check icon; skipped if already Approved).
Confirm campus status is Approved. Filter Campus status → Approved; GT-2026-06-241640 row shows Approved badge. College handoff to Student.
Open college Applications (monitor pipeline). Campus-wide application list. Student rows may appear after the student applies in the next phase.
Log in as student (Arjun Verma). Student dashboard loads. Student must have a primary CV on profile to apply.
Open Browse Internships. List of internships visible to IIT Madras. Guided posting should appear if publish step included your campus.
Search for the guided internship by marker. Table filters to rows matching the GT- session marker in the role/title column.
Click Apply on the guided internship row. Success toast; status badge changes from Open to Applied (or similar). If blocked, check CV on student profile.
Confirm application status on list. Same row shows Applied (not Open). Note student name for employer step.
Log in as employer. Employer hub loads.
Open Applications — Internships tab. Internships tab selected; table shows program applications (not placement drives).
Search applicants by guided internship marker. Filters to Arjun Verma (or the student who applied) for the GT- internship opening.
Shortlist the applicant. Status changes from Applied to Shortlisted; Shortlist button disappears.
Select the shortlisted candidate. Status becomes Selected. Select / Reject buttons appear only when shortlisted.
Filter list to Selected and confirm. Applicant row shows Selected badge. Pipeline step complete.
Log in as student — view application status. Student sees updated status (Selected) on My Applications → Internships.
Open My Applications — Internships. Application for the GT- internship shows Selected (or latest employer status).
College administrator role. IIT Madras performs campus-side steps.

College assigns campus guide for the intern. Programs and Drives → Internship guides. Find the selected student for the GT- internship. Click Assign guide, enter faculty name, email, and notes, then save.
Open Internship guides. Cards list selected and in-progress interns on your campus.
Assign campus guide — manual. Enter guide name, department, email, and notes for the student. Save updates the card.
Employer role. Tech Corporation HR performs employer-side steps.
Employer assigns company supervisor. Student Opportunities → Internship supervisors for selected or in-progress interns.
Open Internship supervisors. Intern cards for your company; Assign supervisor opens the contact form.
Assign company supervisor — manual. Enter supervisor name, team or role, email, phone, and notes for the intern.
Open Internship Progress Reviews. Table of selected interns; Add or Edit opens employer feedback form. Student feedback shows read-only when present.
Submit employer internship progress review — manual. Optional star rating plus feedback text of at least ten characters.
Student role. Arjun Verma performs student-side steps.
Student opens Internship Progress Reviews. Campus guide and company supervisor blocks appear when assigned. Submit student feedback on the same page.
Navigate to Internship Progress Reviews. Selected internship card with guide, supervisor, and feedback form.
Submit student internship progress review — manual. Star rating optional; feedback text at least ten characters.
College administrator role. IIT Madras performs campus-side steps.
College reviews internship progress review (read-only). Internship Outcomes → Internship Progress Reviews. Table shows student and employer submissions; Export CSV available.
Open Internship Progress Reviews. Rows appear after at least one side submits feedback.
Verify guide card shows company supervisor. On Internship guides, the same intern card shows campus guide you assigned and employer supervisor read-only.
